title: Pick the matching entry for packages listed more than once in pylock.toml

@@ -0,0 +1,2 @@

+    def _narrow_package_entries(
+        self, environment: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None
+    ) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
+        """Narrow packages listed more than once to the entry for the environment.
+
+        PEP 751 lets a lock list a package several times with different
+        markers (e.g. one version per Python range), and requires all entries
+        to narrow down to a single one at install time. Pipfile.lock holds one
+        entry per name, so pick it here instead of keeping whichever comes last.
+
+        Args:
+            environment: Marker variables that override the running
+                interpreter's (e.g. the target virtualenv's Python version)
+
+        Returns:
+            One package entry per name, in the order of their first entry
+
+        Raises:
+            PylockFormatError: If more than one entry for a name matches
+        """
+        from pipenv.patched.pip._vendor.packaging.markers import (
+            InvalidMarker,
+            Marker,
+        )
+
+        entries_by_name: Dict[str, List[Dict[str, Any]]] = {}
+        for package in self.packages:
+            name = package.get("name")
+            if name:
+                entries_by_name.setdefault(name.lower(), []).append(package)
+
+        marker_environment = {
+            **(environment or {}),
+            "extras": frozenset(self.extras),
+            "dependency_groups": frozenset(self.dependency_groups)
+            | frozenset(self.default_groups),
+        }
+
+        def matches(package: Dict[str, Any]) -> bool:
+            marker = package.get("marker")
+            if not marker:
+                return True
+            try:
+                return Marker(marker).evaluate(
+                    environment=marker_environment, context="lock_file"
+                )
+            except InvalidMarker:
+                return True
+
+        result = []
+        for name, entries in entries_by_name.items():
+            if len(entries) == 1:
+                result.append(entries[0])
+                continue
+            matching = [package for package in entries if matches(package)]
+            if len(matching) > 1:
+                raise PylockFormatError(
+                    f"Package {name!r} has {len(matching)} entries that match the "
+                    "environment; they must narrow down to a single entry"
+                )
+            # With no match, keep an entry whose marker excludes the
+            # environment, so the package is skipped like a single entry.
+            result.append(matching[0] if matching else entries[0])
+        return result
+
+    def convert_to_pipenv_lockfile(
+        self, environment: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None
+    ) -> Dict[str, Any]:

+            environment: Marker variables that override the running
+                interpreter's, used to pick between entries of a package
+                listed more than once
+
         Returns:
             A dictionary in Pipfile.lock format
         """

@@ -0,0 +1,69 @@
+import pytest
+
+from pipenv.utils.pylock import PylockFile, PylockFormatError
+
+PY310 = {"python_version": "3.10", "python_full_version": "3.10.20"}
+PY312 = {"python_version": "3.12", "python_full_version": "3.12.4"}
+
+NUMPY_OLD = """
+[[packages]]
+name = 'numpy'
+version = '1.26.4'
+marker = "python_version < '3.12'"
+"""
+NUMPY_NEW = """
+[[packages]]
+name = 'numpy'
+version = '2.3.0'
+marker = "python_version >= '3.12'"
+"""
+
+
+def _write_pylock(tmp_path, content):
+    path = tmp_path / "pylock.toml"
+    path.write_text("lock-version = '1.0'\ncreated-by = 'test-tool'\n" + content)
+    return PylockFile.from_path(path)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("content", [NUMPY_OLD + NUMPY_NEW, NUMPY_NEW + NUMPY_OLD])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "environment, version", [(PY310, "==1.26.4"), (PY312, "==2.3.0")]
+)
+def test_convert_picks_the_entry_matching_the_environment(
+    tmp_path, content, environment, version
+):
+    pylock = _write_pylock(tmp_path, content)
+
+    lockfile = pylock.convert_to_pipenv_lockfile(environment=environment)
+
+    assert lockfile["default"]["numpy"]["version"] == version
+
+
+def test_convert_keeps_an_excluded_entry_when_none_matches(tmp_path):
+    pylock = _write_pylock(
+        tmp_path,
+        NUMPY_OLD + NUMPY_OLD.replace("1.26.4", "1.26.3").replace("'3.12'", "'3.11'"),
+    )
+
+    lockfile = pylock.convert_to_pipenv_lockfile(environment=PY312)
+
+    assert lockfile["default"]["numpy"]["version"] == "==1.26.4"
+    assert lockfile["default"]["numpy"]["markers"] == "python_version < '3.12'"
+
+
+def test_convert_rejects_entries_that_dont_narrow_to_one(tmp_path):
+    pylock = _write_pylock(tmp_path, NUMPY_NEW + NUMPY_NEW.replace("2.3.0", "2.3.1"))
+
+    with pytest.raises(PylockFormatError, match="'numpy' has 2 entries"):
+        pylock.convert_to_pipenv_lockfile(environment=PY312)
+
+
+def test_convert_keeps_the_order_of_first_entries(tmp_path):
+    pylock = _write_pylock(
+        tmp_path,
+        NUMPY_OLD + "\n[[packages]]\nname = 'click'\nversion = '8.5.0'\n" + NUMPY_NEW,
+    )
+
+    lockfile = pylock.convert_to_pipenv_lockfile(environment=PY312)
+
+    assert list(lockfile["default"]) == ["numpy", "click"]
